title: 第987章 刺骨第985章 利弊
slug: 人在玄幻写日记我真不是曹贼啊
content_zh:
“我才是……无敌的！”
“啊啊啊啊——！！！”
两道撕裂喉咙、裹挟无尽疲意与癫狂的嘶吼几乎同时响彻登仙台之巅，声浪震荡四周流转的九色霞光。
这二人，被楚歌抛出的“虚假任务”折磨长达一月有余，一路相互厮杀、彼此算计。
又在白玉天梯之上被仙帝法则威压层层压榨，耗尽肉身、神魂之内每一丝潜能与气运。
此刻靠着胸中那股超乎常人的惊人意志力，身躯重重一扑。
双双摔落在第九十九阶阶梯的尽头，踏入祭坛顶层平台。
“砰！”
两声沉闷的巨响接连响起，林天与叶辰如同两滩脱力的烂泥，重重瘫倒在冰凉的石台上。
二人胸膛剧烈起伏，大口大口急促喘息，贪婪地吞咽着祭坛上空充盈仙韵的空气。
他们浑身骨骼遍布裂痕，多处粉碎，虚弱到连微微挪动一根手指的力气都彻底耗尽。
可沾染鲜血的面庞之上，却同步绽开极致狂喜、近乎癫狂的笑容，眼底燃烧着憧憬仙道的火光。
“赢了……我赢了……”
“仙帝传承……是我的了！”
林天与叶辰近乎同一时刻，榨干体内残存最后一丝气力，艰难地抬起沉重的头颅。
二人心中满怀登临无上仙道、执掌乾坤、君临天下的无限憧憬，目光灼灼。
一齐朝着祭坛正中央那处象征仙帝传承的高台望去。
在二人脑海之中，早已无数次勾勒出传承现世的景象。
他们满心认定，下一刻便会见到一尊慈悲伟岸、气韵苍茫的仙帝虚影伫立高台。
又或是数本大道金光萦绕、记载无上法门的天书静静悬浮。

再不济，也该有一汪神异仙池，可供他们修复满身重创、重塑肉身，一步踏足飞升大道。
然而。
当头颅彻底抬起，视线穿透浮动的霞光，清晰看清高台之上的景象刹那。
两人脸上那浓烈到极致的狂喜与癫狂，如同被寒冰骤然封冻，在一瞬间，彻彻底底、完完全全僵硬凝固。
布满纵横血丝的瞳孔猛地向内收缩，骤然缩至针尖大小，呼吸骤然戛然而止。
一股源自灵魂深处的震颤席卷全身，仿佛亲眼目睹了普天之下最匪夷所思、荒诞到极致的恐怖景象。
视线投向祭坛中央高台，预想之中的景象全然不见。
没有道韵缠身、仙气缥缈的老者，也没有悬浮虚空、绽放万丈神光的大道天书。
视野之内，仅有一张恢弘宽大、格调奢华的白玉王座。
王座表面铺着一层蓬松柔软、不染尘埃的雪白灵狐皮，莹润玉光与皮毛的皓白交相辉映。
而王座之上，一名白衣青年正慵懒斜倚，身姿闲散自在。
他容颜俊秀超凡，眉目宛若天神雕琢，气质从容淡漠。
content_en:
"I am... invincible!"
“Ahhhhhh——!!!”
Two roars that tore through the throat and carried endless fatigue and madness almost simultaneously resounded to the top of the Immortal Platform, and the sound waves shook the nine-color glow flowing around.
The two of them were tortured by the "fake mission" thrown by Chu Ge for more than a month, fighting and plotting against each other along the way.
And on the white jade ladder to heaven, he was squeezed layer by layer by the Immortal Emperor's law, exhausting every ounce of potential and luck in his body and soul.
At this moment, relying on the amazing willpower in his chest that was beyond ordinary people, his body swooped heavily.
They both fell at the end of the ninety-ninth step and stepped onto the top platform of the altar.
"Bang!"
Two dull loud noises sounded one after another, and Lin Tian and Ye Chen collapsed heavily on the cold stone platform like two pools of exhausted mud.
The two's chests rose and fell violently, breathing heavily and greedily swallowing the fairy-filled air above the altar.
Their bones were covered with cracks and shattered in many places, and they were so weak that they could barely move a finger.
But on the face stained with blood, a smile of extreme ecstasy and almost madness broke out at the same time, and the fire of longing for the immortal way burned in his eyes.
"I won...I won..."
"The inheritance of the Immortal Emperor...is mine!"
At almost the same moment, Lin Tian and Ye Chen squeezed out the last bit of strength remaining in their bodies and raised their heavy heads with difficulty.
The two of them were filled with the infinite longing to ascend to the supreme immortal path, control the universe, and dominate the world, and their eyes were blazing.
They all looked towards the high platform in the center of the altar that symbolized the inheritance of the Immortal Emperor.
In the minds of the two of them, they have already sketched out the scene of inheritance in this world countless times.
They were fully convinced that the next moment they would see the shadow of a benevolent and majestic Immortal Emperor standing on a high platform.
Or there are several heavenly books lingering in golden light and recording the supreme Dharma, floating quietly.
No matter how bad it is, there should be a magical fairy pool where they can repair their severe injuries, reshape their bodies, and step onto the road to ascension.
However.
When his head was completely raised, his sight penetrated the floating rays of light, and he could clearly see the scene on the high platform.
The extremely intense ecstasy and madness on their faces seemed to be suddenly frozen by ice. In an instant, they were completely and completely frozen.
The pupils covered with bloodshot eyes suddenly shrank inward, shrinking to the size of a needle tip, and breathing suddenly stopped.
A tremor originating from the depths of his soul swept through his body, as if he had witnessed the most unbelievable, absurd and terrifying scene in the world.
Looking towards the high platform in the center of the altar, the scene he expected was completely gone.
There is no old man with Tao charm and ethereal immortality, and there is no Taoist book suspended in the void and blooming with divine light.
Within the field of vision, there is only a majestic, spacious and luxurious white jade throne.
The surface of the throne is covered with a layer of fluffy, soft, dust-free snow-white spirit fox fur, and the jade-like light complements the whiteness of the fur.
On the throne, a young man in white is reclining lazily, with a leisurely posture.
He has an extraordinary handsome face, his eyebrows are like those carved by the gods, and his temperament is calm and indifferent.
